title: CodeXX rule manifest
description: Manifest for a rule published to the CodeXX rules registry (ADR-081 section 3).

schemaVersion.description: Version of this manifest schema. Only 1 exists.

id.description: ADR-079 identity: vendor.rulename, both segments [a-z0-9-]+, exactly one dot. Must equal kebab(vendor) + '.' + kebab(rule).

vendor.description: Vendor tag. Must match the parent directory name. 'codexx' is reserved to CodeXX-DTDK org members (ADR-081 section 6).

rule.description: Rule name. Must match the rule directory name, and is the C++ attribute token the rule matches: [[codegen::<rule>]].

version.description: Rule version, semver MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Must increase on every content change. No channels, no prerelease labels.

description.description: One sentence describing what the rule generates. Shown in index.json and on the registry listing.

authors.description: Credit for the rule. The bundled LICENSE is the repo-wide MIT; attribution lives here (ADR-081 section 6).

license.description: SPDX identifier. Published rules are MIT; the bundled LICENSE must be byte-identical to the repo root LICENSE.

keywords.description: Optional search terms for the registry listing.

outputLanguage.description: Must agree with output.language in config.yaml. Denormalized here so index.json is self-contained.

requires.description: Component version constraints, ADR-067 section 2 grammar: '>=X.Y.Z' or '>=X.Y.Z <A.B.C'. No caret, no tilde.

yanked.description: Set true to withdraw this rule. Propagates to index.json. The published tag is never deleted (ADR-036 section 5).
